title: 第9章枷锁第10章无妄
slug: 天行健君子以自强不息
content_zh:
【剧情回顾】
中元夜。阴气最盛之时。
苍云山护山大阵全力运转。
九位元婴长老齐守后山禁地。
林天行在癸字院最偏僻的小屋里。翻开了混沌诀第四页。
混沌之力与盘古精血产生了远超修炼理论的反应。
精血融化。还原。渗透。
从半固态退回到最原始的本源状态。
与他的凡人之躯进行更深层次的融合。
不是淬炼。不是改造。是真正的“成为“。
三天混沌。外界三柱香。
当他苏醒时。修为已从未入流直接跨入练气一层。
混沌诀突破至第五页。
第五页的圆环中。灰色彻底褪尽。
取而代之的是一片深邃到没有尽头的黑暗。
黑暗中。有什么东西在注视着他。
七月十八。清晨。
林天行从混沌中醒来。
窗外山泉的流水声比平时更清晰了。
不是水声变大了。是他的听觉变敏锐了。

敏锐到能分辨出每一滴泉水落在潭面上激起的细微差别。
能听出水流在石缝中转弯时摩擦青苔的沙沙声。
甚至能听到水潭底下沉积的细沙被水流推动时互相碰撞的窸窣声。
他的视觉也不同了。
仰面躺在床上。他能看到屋顶房梁上每一道木纹的走向。
能看清角落里那只蜘蛛网上每一根丝线的交错。
能分辨出窗外枣树叶片上被虫子啃出的缺口形状。
这些细节他以前也能看到。但需要凑近了仔细看。
现在不需要。
他只是随意地睁着眼。那些细节就自然而然地涌入了感知。
不需要刻意聚焦。不需要眯眼调整。
就像世界本身的清晰度被什么东西拧高了一个档次。
修为的提升是全方位的。
力量。速度。反应。感知。对天地灵气的亲和力。
全部在练气一层这个门槛上。获得了一次质的飞跃。
他的经脉中流淌的不再是若有若无的金色暖流。
而是一股可以被明确感知的。持续运转的灵力。
灵力的属性很模糊。
不像苏云袖的火灵力那样炽热暴烈。
不像慕容羽的风灵力那样轻灵迅疾。

不像铁战的土灵力那样厚重沉稳。
他的灵力没有任何明确的属性偏向。
content_en:
【Plot review】
Zhongyuan night. When the Yin Qi is at its strongest.
Cangyun Mountain's mountain-protecting formation is operating at full capacity.
The nine Yuanying elders guarded the forbidden area in the back mountain.
Lin Tianxing was in the most remote hut in Guiziyuan. Opened the fourth page of Chaos Art.
The power of chaos and Pangu's essence and blood produced a reaction that far exceeded the theory of cultivation.
Essence and blood melt. reduction. penetration.
Return from the semi-solid state to the most primitive state.
A deeper integration with his mortal body.
Not tempering. Not a transformation. It is truly "becoming".
Three days of chaos. Three sticks of incense from outside.
When he wakes up. The cultivation base has directly entered the first level of Qi training from entering the flow.
Chaos Art breaks through to the fifth page.
In the circle on page five. The gray is completely gone.
What replaced it was a deep and endless darkness.
in the dark. Something was watching him.
July 18th. early morning.
Lin Tianxing woke up from chaos.
The sound of running water from the mountain spring outside the window was clearer than usual.
It’s not that the sound of the water has gotten louder. It was his hearing that had become acute.
He is so keen that he can distinguish the subtle differences caused by every drop of spring water falling on the surface of the pool.
You can hear the rustle of water rubbing against moss as it turns in the cracks in the rocks.
You can even hear the sound of the fine sand deposited at the bottom of the pool colliding with each other as it is pushed by the current.
His vision was different too.
Lie on your back on the bed. He could see the direction of every wood grain on the roof beams.
I can clearly see the interlacing of every thread in the spider's web in the corner.
I can distinguish the shape of the gaps gnawed by insects on the leaves of the jujube trees outside the window.
He had seen these details before. But you need to get closer and take a closer look.
Not needed now.
He just opened his eyes casually. Those details just flow into the perception naturally.
No need to focus deliberately. No squinting adjustment required.
It's like the clarity of the world itself has been turned up a notch by something.
The improvement of cultivation is all-round.
strength. speed. reaction. Perception. Affinity for the spiritual energy of heaven and earth.
All on the threshold of the first level of Qi training. A qualitative leap was achieved.
What was flowing through his meridians was no longer the faint golden warmth.
But one that can be clearly perceived. Continuously operating spiritual power.
The properties of spiritual power are very vague.
It's not as hot and violent as Su Yunxiu's fire spirit power.
It's not as light and fast as Murong Yu's wind spirit power.
It's not as heavy and steady as Tie Zhan's earth spiritual power.
His spiritual power does not have any clear attribute preference.
